title: Map keys can contain balanced brackets in a bean property path
summary: A balanced bracket inside a literal map key now selects the intended child. A quoted write left the similarly named decoy untouched.

change.description: Property access now finds the bracket that closes the whole map key, accounting for balanced brackets inside that key.

notes: A direct read from the backing Java map checks both children and counts its keys after the write.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-beans 5.1.6.RELEASE. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
